training_dataset.name: dahiti_egypt_water_level_training_dataset.csv
training_dataset.source: original DAHITI observations; no interpolation or aggregation
training_dataset.time_semantics: irregular observation horizon; use horizon_days for elapsed-time analysis

evaluation_notes.forecasting: Forecast metrics must be compared with the time-based benchmark, not the in-model random split.
evaluation_notes.state_classification: State labels are deterministic threshold policies and are reported separately from forecasting quality.
evaluation_notes.generalization: Model complexity is regularized. The latest temporal holdout beats persistence, but early-history walk-forward evaluation remains a known limitation.
